Job Description
 Ciklum is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team full-time in Romania.
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
 About The Role
 As a Senior DevOps Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.
Our client's infrastructure powers millions of live sports events worldwide - from raw video capture at remote venues to real-time stream delivery and ML-driven monetization. As a DevOps & Platform Engineer, you will be a core contributor to the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our cloud platform.
You'll work inside a self-service, pod-based engineering model where your job is to build the platforms, pipelines, and guardrails that let product teams ship independently - at high velocity and with full operational ownership. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact individual contributor role with a clear technical growth path.
 Responsibilities
Build and maintain GitOps-based delivery pipelines (ArgoCD) so product pods deploy safely without DevOps intervention
Design and evolve self-service tooling - golden paths, deployment templates, scaffolding - that reduce pod dependency on the platform team
Implement deployment safety guardrails: config diffing, change ownership, rollout strategies, and audit trails
Adopt industry-leading AI tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, automation, and operational delivery
 Requirements
5+ years in infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering roles
Production-grade Kubernetes experience: EKS/GKE, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), service mesh, multi-tenant cluster operations, resource management
Deep hands-on GitOps and CI/CD: ArgoCD or Flux, Kustomize/Helm, rollout strategies, deployment safety, change ownership, audit trails
AWS platform depth: EC2, EKS, S3, CloudFront, IAM/IRSA, VPC networking, RDS, cost optimization levers
Platform engineering orientation - you think in platforms and self-service, not one-off scripts or manual runbooks
AI-first approach - actively uses AI tools to accelerate development and operations; not just aware of them, but fluent
Ownership mentality - own outcomes end-to-end, escalate only when truly blocked, and translate infrastructure complexity into business impact
People leadership skills, including mentoring and developing engineers, as well as conducting technical interviews
 Desirable
GCP experience (GKE, GCS, Cloud Run) or hybrid multi-cloud operations
Video streaming infrastructure: HLS, RTMP, CDN optimization, live video pipelines
FinOps / cost optimization: cost attribution, right-sizing, storage lifecycle policies
Development background (Python, Go, Node.js, or similar)
 What’s in it for you?
Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice
Care: Medical subscription to Regina Maria, meal tickets of 40 ron net/day worked
 About Us
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
In Romania, we welcome top-tier tech talent — whether from our Bucharest office or fully remotely. Tap into deep industry knowledge, grow your career, and make an impact in an empowering environment.
 Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!
 Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.
